240-4359-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-4359-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

803-997-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-997-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

1251-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1251-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3558-4336-4668-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3558-4336-4668-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

876-7070-7221.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
876-7070-7221.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Lys Alana Dignitary.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Lys Alana Dignitary.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Lys Alana Dignitary.
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Lys Alana Dignitary.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lys Alana Dignitary.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lys Alana Dignitary from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2842-5220-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1170-2054-2440-7517.description:
Cast the copy of Aqueous Aria spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
When Campus Composer enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 3/3 Elemental creature token with flying.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Pay an additional {2}{U} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding {C}{C}{C} from the Mana Echoes triggers.
Pay an additional {1}{U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding six {C}.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 10 any number of times.
1170-2054-2440-7517.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional Merfolk, Bard, and Elemental you control.

147-5231-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5231-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5231-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

423-1437-1671-3177--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-1671-3177--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2498-4691-7074.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-4691-7074.description:
Activate Koh by paying 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Koh abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4050-5010-5243-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

104-2034-3490-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
104-2034-3490-6458.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-3967-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

6709-6869-6884.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
6709-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master by paying {2}{W}
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

3293-4826-5226-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-4826-5226-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-4826-5226-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

339-677-5223-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1358-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
1358-4222-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
1358-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1429-2829-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2829-4875-5402.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1978-2364-3088.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-4474-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Gilder Bairn.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4474-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-4927.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3430-3525-3793-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
3430-3525-3793-4758.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding nine {C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

427-2054-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least three cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-2054-4222.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1512-1651-3263.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster and another artifact, targeting Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token that is also an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

803-2141-4499-4508-4793.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2141-4499-4508-4793.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3} to exile Swarming Goblins and return it to the battlefield.
Swarming Goblins enters the battlefield, rolling a die and creating at least one 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Brazen Dwarf triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {3}.
Repeat.

2525-4283-4338-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2525-4283-4338-5295.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing itself and any other creature you control, targeting Body Double.
Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Whisper ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Whisper.
Activate Body Double by tapping it, sacrificing itself and the Zombie token, targeting Whisper.
Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Whisper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
